newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme Tissue Carticel review scheduled.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme Tissue Carticel review scheduled.

text.p: Genzyme Corp's Tissue Repair Division said that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has included the company's biologics license application for the Carticel service on the agenda of the FDA's Orthopedic and Rehabilitation Devices Panel meeting scheduled for March 6.
The Carticel service employs a proprietary process to grow a patient's own cartilage cells to repair knee damage.
According to Genzyme, the service was extensively reviewed in 1995 by the FDA and determined to fall outside existing regulations.
The service has been marketed unregulated since July 1995.
In May 1996, the FDA published a new regulatory policy for such products and services.
